findings.title: Router /customer collision resolved by declaration order + index removal, not sibling analogy
findings.detail: CustomerLayout is at '/customer' with an index child (CustomerHomePage) + t/:code + history. MapOrderPage must win the exact '/customer' match: (1) REMOVE the CustomerHomePage index child or it wins '/customer'; (2) declare MapOrderPage so it resolves at '/customer' while '/customer/t/:code' and '/customer/history' still resolve via CustomerLayout. The '/customer/login' sibling analogy is loose (login is a different path). Frame it as shared-path ranking + ordering, not 'like login'.
findings.suggested_fix: WI-4: remove the CustomerHomePage index child; place MapOrderPage as the '/customer' leaf; keep t/:code + history as CustomerLayout children. The rewritten e2e hits both '/customer' and '/customer/t/:code' so a mis-order fails CI empirically.

findings.title: buildOrderRequest Estimate mapping: set estimatedPriceCzk NULL (range is not a point value)
findings.detail: PriceQuoteView estimate variant has lowCzk/highCzk/distanceKm/durationMin — NO single point value. The proven CustomOrderPage.test.tsx contract sends estimatedPriceCzk: null for Estimate orders (server recomputes). buildOrderRequest.test.ts is dev-written, so a wrong expectation (midpoint/lowCzk as estimatedPriceCzk) passes its own test but diverges from the API contract.
findings.suggested_fix: For an Estimate view, buildOrderRequest sets estimatedPriceCzk: null (match existing contract). Only Fixed carries a concrete price (fixedPriceCzk + routeId). Pass distanceM/durationS from the quote if available (quote-once) but NOT a fabricated point price.

findings.title: FixedPriceBadge orphaned after RouteOrderPage deletion, not on removal list
findings.detail: FixedPriceBadge.tsx is consumed ONLY by RouteOrderPage (deleted by WI-4) but is not on the removal list -> silent dead code (tsc stays green since nothing imports it).
findings.suggested_fix: Add FixedPriceBadge.tsx (+ test if present) to the WI-4 removal list, or explicitly retain it.

findings.title: Meter/unknown view -> Order disabled; buildOrderRequest only invoked for fixed/estimate
findings.detail: The 'unknown' PriceQuoteView kind (malformed/no-quote) is not explicitly mapped in buildOrderRequest's priceType spec. Ensure both 'meter' and 'unknown' disable Order (fallback message) so buildOrderRequest is not called on an unknown view.
findings.suggested_fix: WI-3: both meter and unknown disable Order. If buildOrderRequest must accept them, define priceType explicitly in WI-1 (likely Meter, no price fields).
